Body.Content:
The Azure SQL Knowledge Source capability extends the range of enterprise data sources that makers can leverage when building agents in Copilot Studio. This enables organizations to bring business-critical information stored in Azure SQL into their agent experiences using the same knowledge-centric approach that customers already use across other supported knowledge sources. Azure SQL knowledge support represents another step toward a unified knowledge platform strategy, where customers can connect enterprise data sources through a common knowledge framework and leverage those sources consistently across agent experiences. It also strengthens the story for organizations seeking to build grounded, enterprise-ready AI solutions using existing Microsoft data assets.

GA date: September CY2026

Preview date: August CY2026
